lines.en: label sadgirls4:
scene harukaoutdoor1
Someone who doesn’t seem to have a problem holding {i}anything{/i} in, though, is Haruka- who is currently sharing her recent fortune with a still noticeably confused Rin.
lines.zh: 不过,有个看起来完全{i}藏不住话{/i}的人是 Haruka——她这会儿正把自己最近的好运讲给一脸茫然的 Rin 听。

lines.en: At least she’s not the {i}only{/i} one confused.
lines.zh: 至少困惑的人不止她{i}一个{/i}。

lines.en: It’s hard enough figuring out how to deal with a woman who lost her husband. Jumping directly from that to a woman who {i}gained{/i} a husband is just more than I can process this early in the morning.
lines.zh: 光是弄清楚该怎么面对一个失去丈夫的女人就已经够难的了。紧接着又要面对一个「{i}重新得到{/i}」丈夫的女人,这实在超出我一大早能处理的信息量。

lines.en: But at least it seems like Haruka isn’t diving headfirst into celebration mode based on her current expression.
lines.zh: 但至少从 Haruka 现在的表情来看,她并没有一头扎进庆祝模式。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
I’m sure that our talk last night might have something to do with that, though.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定,这大概和我们昨晚那场谈话有关。

lines.en: : But...wait. If {i}your{/i} husband is okay, what about Makoto’s mom’s husband?
lines.zh: : 可是……等等。如果{i}你的{/i}丈夫没事,那 Makoto 她妈妈的丈夫呢?

lines.en: : That’s gotta have something to do with-
lines.zh: : 那肯定跟这事有关——

lines.en: : That’s...not really something I think I should be discussing with you. I just wanted to give you an update about {i}my{/i} situation since I know you’ve been, uhh...curious about it.
lines.zh: : 那个……我觉得我不该跟你讨论。我只是想跟你说说{i}我这边{/i}的情况,因为我知道你一直,呃……挺好奇的。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor2
: Well, I’m really happy for you. That’s great news.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我真的为你高兴。这是个好消息。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
scene harukaoutdoor3
: But, uhh...what exactly does that mean for Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不过,呃……那对 Sensei 来说意味着什么?

lines.en: : I thought you were leaving with Maki. I didn’t realize you were right behind me.
lines.zh: : 我以为你跟 Maki 一起走了。没想到你就跟在我后面。

lines.en: : Maki went off to meet up with Sara, I think. What’s this about me?
lines.zh: : Maki 应该是去找 Sara 了。这跟我有什么关系?

lines.en: : Just...well...
: Aren’t you two, like...you know...
lines.zh: : 你们俩不是,那个……你知道的……

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor4
: Actually, I want to keep my job, so I probably shouldn’t say it right now.
lines.zh: : 其实我还想保住这份工作,所以现在大概不该说。

lines.en: : That’s not...
lines.zh: : 不是那……

lines.en: : Things are a lot more complicated than that!
lines.zh: : 事情比那复杂多了!

lines.en: : Wouldn’t flat out denying it work a little better here, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 直接否认不是效果更好吗,Haruka?

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor5
: I can’t deny it when she already knows.
lines.zh: : 她都已经知道了,我没法否认。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m not wrong, am I? You told me just last night that my, uhh...circumstances are all messed up.
lines.zh: : 再说了,我又没说错,不是吗?你昨晚才跟我说过,我的,呃……处境一团糟。

lines.en: : Did you change your mind after a night’s sleep? Or were those just words you used back then to try and soothe me?
lines.zh: : 睡了一觉就改主意了?还是说那些话只是你当时用来哄我的?

lines.en: : You know what? I just remembered that I have dishes to wash. And that this is something you two should probably figure out without me in the picture.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?我突然想起来我还有盘子要洗。而且这事你们俩大概该背着我自己解决。
: 不行……

lines.en: : You need to stay here and watch the store while he and I have an actual conversation. One where I don’t rip my shirt open and try to get him to screw me.
lines.zh: : 你得留在这儿看店,我要跟他好好谈一谈。一场我不会撕开衬衫、求他操我的谈话。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor6
: On second thought, maybe this {i}is{/i} something I should be involved in?
lines.zh: : 再想想,也许这事我该参与一下?

lines.en: : You two basically are my second set of adoptive parents anyway.  And my first set never gave me the sex talk because girls can’t get other girls pregnant.
lines.zh: : 反正你们俩基本上就是我的第二对养父母。而我第一对父母从没给我做过性教育,因为女孩又不能让别的女孩怀孕。

lines.en: : I’m going to take your {i}father{/i} outside now, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我现在要把你{i}爸爸{/i}带到外面去,Rin。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor7
: Okay, Mom. Don’t press your bodies up against the glass when you inevitably go at it. I’m the one who has to clean them.
lines.zh: : 好的,妈。你们等会儿干起来的时候,别把身子贴在玻璃上。最后擦玻璃的人可是我。

lines.en: : Noted.
lines.zh: : 知道了。

lines.en: else:
scene harukaoutdoor8
: But, uhh...what exactly does that mean for Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不过,呃……那对 Sensei 来说到底意味着什么?

lines.en: : Wha-
: I thought you left with Maki? What are you still doing here?
lines.zh: : 我还以为你跟 Maki 走了呢?你怎么还在这儿?

lines.en: : Maki ran off to go meet up with Sara. What’s all this about me?
lines.zh: : Maki 跑去见 Sara 了。这到底跟我有什么关系?

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor9
: Nothing. Nobody here wants to fuck you. {i}Especially{/i} nobody named Haruka.
lines.zh: : 没什么。这儿没人想操你。{i}尤其是{/i}没有一个叫 Haruka 的人想操你。

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me right now? Is this really the time for that?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在开玩笑吗?现在是说这个的时候吗?

lines.en: : Time for what? I’m just here to make coffee and keep secrets.
lines.zh: : 说什么的时机?我只是来煮咖啡和保守秘密的。

lines.en: : Besides, just {i}wanting{/i} to do something isn’t a big deal unless you actually do it, right?
lines.zh: : 再说了,光是{i}想{/i}做点什么又不是什么大事,只要不真的做,对吧?

lines.en: : I figured by now that both of you were well aware of the sexual tension and just not giving into it because you knew it would be fucked up.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你们俩早就心知肚明那股性张力,只是因为知道会很糟糕才没有顺从它。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor10
: If you ask me, though- I’m on Team Sensei because at least he is {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过要我说——我站 Sensei 这边,因为至少他{i}在这儿{/i}。

lines.en: : Okay...I’m going to go outside now so I can have a real conversation with him. And you’re going to stay {i}here{/i} and watch the store so I can do that.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我现在要出去,好跟他好好谈一谈。而你要留在{i}这儿{/i}看店,好让我谈成。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor11
: Aye aye, Captain Haruka. You two enjoy your fun adult conversation where you pretend you don’t want to bang.
lines.zh: : 遵命,Haruka 船长。祝你们这场装作不想上床的愉快成人对话玩得开心。

lines.en: : I’m sorry about her.
lines.zh: : 我为她的事道歉。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ve come to accept her the way she is and you should too.
lines.zh: : 没事。我已经接受了她本来的样子,你也该这样。

lines.en: : Also, it’s not like she’s {i}wrong.{/i} I know for one that I-
lines.zh: : 而且,她说得也{i}没错{/i}。至少我知道我——

lines.en: : Please don’t finish that sentence. I can already tell that it’s going to do more harm than good.
lines.zh: : 求你别把那句话说完。我已经看出来了,说下去只会坏事。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on. It’ll be easier to talk without the world’s nosiest teenager getting all up in our business.
lines.zh: : 走吧。没有全世界最爱管闲事的青少年掺和,会好谈得多。

lines.en: : Hey! I have a {i}cute{/i} nose! Otoha tells me all the time!
lines.zh: : 喂!我的鼻子很{i}可爱{/i}!Otoha 一直这么跟我说!

lines.en: Haruka and I exit the cafe, surveying the surroundings to make sure that no one else is around before we begin what will be my second mature conversation of the day.
lines.zh: 我和 Haruka 走出咖啡馆,环顾四周确认没有旁人在场,然后才准备开始我今天第二场成熟的对话。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
Or at least what I {i}hope{/i} will be my second mature conversation of the day.
lines.zh: 至少是我{i}希望{/i}会成为今天第二场成熟对话的那一场。

lines.en: Given what happened the {i}last{/i} time Haruka and I tried to talk, I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: 考虑到{i}上一次{/i}我和 Haruka 试图谈话的结果,我实在没什么把握。

lines.en: else:
Unless Haruka plans on just excitedly freaking out about her husband being alive again.
lines.zh: 除非 Haruka 打算只是兴奋地为自己丈夫还活着而发疯。

lines.en: Which, based on the brief conversation we had yesterday, seems highly probable.
lines.zh: 而根据我们昨天那段简短的对话,这种可能性相当高。

lines.en: It does seem that I’m actually more involved than I thought, though, if what Rin said has any truth to it.
lines.zh: 不过如果 Rin 说的有几分真,那我卷入的程度似乎比我以为的更深。

lines.en: Am I involved enough to have Haruka throw everything else away in an effort to chase me down? Of course not.
lines.zh: 我卷入得够深,深到能让 Haruka 为了追我而抛下一切吗?当然不。

lines.en: But one good conversation could disconnect our paths entirely.
lines.zh: 但一场像样的对话,就可能彻底切断我们两条路。

lines.en: And that’s probably why she wants to do this.
lines.zh: 大概这就是为什么她想谈这一场。

lines.en: scene sky
The one good thing about today (Not counting Haruka’s husband, since I have never met and couldn’t care any less about the guy) is that, at least thus far, the sun has shown us mercy.
lines.zh: 今天唯一的一件好事(不算 Haruka 的丈夫——我从没见过那家伙,也一点都不在乎他),是到目前为止,太阳还算手下留情。

lines.en: It’s still early, though. And life does prove to be inconvenient in more ways than most of us would like to admit. But if it means dodging tragedy in the form of UV rays, I can pretend to be an optimist for a bit.
lines.zh: 不过现在还早。而生活也确实会在很多我们不太愿意承认的方面给人添麻烦。但如果代价是躲开以紫外线形式出现的悲剧,我可以假装当一会儿乐观主义者。

lines.en: It’ll be good to have {i}one{/i} of us fulfill that role, at least- as the sigh that escapes Haruka’s lips as she slouches against the wall reveals that it certainly won’t be her.
lines.zh: 至少我们中有{i}一个{/i}人来扮演这个角色是好事——从 Haruka 靠在墙上时唇间漏出的那声叹息来看,那个人肯定不会是她。

lines.en: And that this change, albeit one much brighter in color than that of her friend, has drastically altered her life out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 而且这场变故——尽管颜色比她朋友的那场要明亮得多——还是在毫无预兆的情况下彻底改变了她的人生。

lines.en: It remains to be seen if it’s what she wants, though.
lines.zh: 不过这到底是不是她想要的,还有待观察。

lines.en: Or if the last several years of being without him have turned her into something she can’t look at anymore.
lines.zh: 或者说,这几年的独守,是否已经把她变成了一个她自己都无法直视的人。

lines.en: scene black
if harukasex == True:
scene harukaoutdoor12
: I owe you an apology.
lines.zh: : 我欠你一个道歉。

lines.en: : You do.
lines.zh: : 确实。

lines.en: : It was way fucked up for me to place the blame on you like that when this was as much of a decision on my end as it was yours.
lines.zh: : 我把责任推到你身上,实在是太混蛋了——毕竟这既是你的决定,也同样是我的决定。

lines.en: : Actually, scratch that. It was {i}more{/i} of a decision on my end than yours. {i}You’re{/i} not the one hurting anyone else by sleeping with me.
lines.zh: : 不,收回那句话。这{i}更{/i}像是我的决定,而不是你的。跟我上床并不会伤害到别人的,不是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re not tied down the same way I am. Or...{i}was.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你没有像我一样被束缚住。或者说……{i}曾经{/i}被束缚住。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m saying is that I’m the one who loosened the knot my husband and I tied and that you were just...there to lend me a hand.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是,是我自己解开了我和丈夫打的那个结,而你只是……恰好在旁边搭了把手。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor13
: You know...this whole {i}marriage{/i} thing...it wasn’t anything like I expected it to be.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……{i}婚姻{/i}这整件事……跟我想象的完全不一样。

lines.en: : I don’t think most newlyweds anticipate a space war coming in between them.
lines.zh: : 我觉得大多数新婚夫妇都不会预料到,会有一场太空战争横在他们中间。

lines.en: : No, I guess they don’t. But even something like that is something I figured I was prepared for back when we first found out.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我想他们不会。不过就连这种事,当初我们刚知道消息的时候,我都以为自己准备好了。

lines.en: : I was still so high on the idea of being with someone I was in love with that there was {i}no{/i} amount of time that I wouldn’t wait for them to come back.
lines.zh: : 那时我还沉浸在与自己爱的人相守的念头里,{i}无论等多久{/i}我都会等他回来。

lines.en: : But here I am, three years later...still married...yet trying to salvage my relationship with the man I’m regularly cheating on my husband with.
lines.zh: : 可三年后的今天……我依然结着婚……却在努力修复我和那个男人的关系——那个我经常背着丈夫偷情的男人。

lines.en: : What does that say about me?
lines.zh: : 这说明了什么?

lines.en: : It says that you’re confused. Which most people would be in your position.
lines.zh: : 说明你很困惑。换作大多数人处在你这个位置,都会困惑。

lines.en: : I’m not mad about what happened last night. I’m used to dealing with people at their worst, and I’m sure it felt like your life was falling apart.
lines.zh: : 我没有为昨晚的事生气。我习惯了应付人最糟糕的样子,而且我敢肯定,当时你感觉自己的人生正在崩塌。

lines.en: : It was the contrast between that and something else that coerced me into walking away, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想,让我最终选择离开的,是那件事和另一件事之间的反差。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor14
: I can only imagine.
lines.zh: : 我能想象。

lines.en: : If I had known back then that Maki’s...
lines.zh: : 如果我当时就知道 Maki 的……

lines.en: : Why didn’t you tell me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不告诉我?

lines.en: : Because I already pissed her off once that day. And I didn’t want to go telling people things she didn’t give me the okay to talk about. Especially someone as close to her as you.
lines.zh: : 因为我那天已经惹她生过一次气了。而且我不想到处说那些她没允许我谈论的事,尤其是对像你这样跟她关系这么近的人。

lines.en: : I get that there was a lot going through your head when you called me, but Maki’s your best friend. You’re better than that.
lines.zh: : 我明白你打给我的时候脑子里一团乱,但 Maki 是你最好的朋友。你不该是这种人。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor15
: I’m not, though.
lines.zh: : 可我就是这样。

lines.en: : Everything I’ve done over the last few years has been mistake after mistake. And a good portion of those mistakes have been {i}repeated{/i} mistakes.
lines.zh: : 这几年我做的每一件事,都是一个错误接着一个错误。而且其中相当一部分,还是{i}重复{/i}犯的错。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many times we’ve had sex? Because I don’t.
lines.zh: : 你知道我们上过多少次床吗?因为我不知道。

lines.en: : What I do know, though, is that every single one of those times was me jamming a knife further and further into my husband’s back.
lines.zh: : 我只知道,每一次,都是我把一把刀往我丈夫背里捅得更深一点。

lines.en: : I honestly wouldn’t be surprised if it was poking out of his abdomen by now.
lines.zh: : 说实话,要是那刀现在已经从他肚子前面捅出来了,我也不会意外。

lines.en: : Can you think of a metaphor a little less gruesome, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能换个没那么血腥的比喻?

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor16
: No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : I deserve the most disgusting and gruesome metaphors my shitty brain can come up with. Anything less wouldn’t be fair.
lines.zh: : 我这颗烂脑子能想出多恶心、多血腥的比喻,我就配得上多恶心、多血腥。轻一点的都不公平。

lines.en: : I still don’t think that what we’ve done is that big of a deal.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得我们做过的事没那么严重。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor17
: No, it {i}is{/i} a big deal! And I really wish you’d stop saying it’s not!
lines.zh: : 不,{i}就是{/i}很严重!我真希望你能别再说不严重了!

lines.en: : This is more than me thinking my husband is gone and emotionlessly using the body of some other man to fill the void he left!
lines.zh: : 这不只是我以为丈夫已经不在了,然后麻木地拿别的男人的身体去填他留下的空洞!

lines.en: : It’s more than me making a little mistake! More than me trying to hide my loneliness the only way I know how!
lines.zh: : 不只是我犯了个小错!不只是我用唯一会的方式去掩盖孤独!

lines.en: : It’s the fact that I {i}know{/i} he’s alive now! That I know he has a chance of coming back!
lines.zh: : 而是我现在{i}知道{/i}他还活着!我知道他还有可能回来!

lines.en: : And that I still want you despite that!
lines.zh: : 而尽管如此,我依然想要你!

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor18

: I don’t want to feel this way anymore...like I’m being forced to choose between two things I want when one of them I can’t even {i}have{/i} and the other is an option I didn’t even realize {i}existed{/i} until I already chose.
lines.zh: : 我不想再这样了……像是被迫在两样我都要的东西之间做选择,而其中一个我根本{i}得不到{/i},另一个则是等我选完了才意识到{i}存在{/i}的选项。

lines.en: : And no. This isn’t me saying that I’m thinking of separating with my husband and just devoting myself to you instead.
lines.zh: : 而且不。我这不是在说我想跟丈夫分开、然后一门心思投奔你。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I can’t help but think sometimes that something like that might be nice.
lines.zh: : 我有时会忍不住想,那样也许挺好的。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m sorry for yelling at you and...saying all of the fucked up shit that I said...and blaming you and not listening and...anything else you want me to apologize for.
lines.zh: : 总之,我很抱歉冲你吼……说了那些乱七八糟的混账话……把责任推给你、又不肯听你说话……还有任何你想让我道歉的事。

lines.en: : You didn’t deserve it.
lines.zh: : 你不该承受这些。

lines.en: : So if you want to go off on me for being selfish and neurotic and just an all around shitty person, you can. Because {i}I{/i} deserve that.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你想骂我自私、神经质、彻头彻尾的烂人,尽管骂。因为{i}我{/i}活该。

lines.en: : If I didn’t, I wouldn’t keep making the same mistakes.
lines.zh: : 如果我不是,我就不会一直犯同样的错。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor19
: I’m not going to go off on you.
lines.zh: : 我不会骂你。

lines.en: : I’d just like some sort of warning beforehand if this winds up happening again. Walking all the way over there just to get yelled at for your shitty behavior kind of sucked.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望下次再发生这种事,你能提前给我个预警。大老远走过去,结果只是因为你的破脾气被骂一顿,挺糟心的。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor20
: You’re...{i}still{/i} going to come over?
lines.zh: : 你……以后{i}还{/i}会来?

lines.en: : Well, {i}somebody’s{/i} gotta fuck you, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯,总得{i}有个人{/i}操你吧,对吧?

lines.en: : That’s...That wasn’t really the point I was trying to-
lines.zh: : 那……我想表达的不是这个——

lines.en: : I know it wasn’t the point you were trying to make.
lines.zh: : 我知道那不是你想表达的重点。

lines.en: : It’s just easier to talk about it like that.
lines.zh: : 只是这样说起来比较容易。

lines.en: else:
scene harukaoutdoor21
: So, umm...
lines.zh: : 那么,嗯……

lines.en: : Can we avoid the part about the sexual tension? Or is that a thing we actually have to address?
lines.zh: : 我们能跳过性张力那部分吗?还是说那件事我们非得谈?

lines.en: : We can avoid it. I’m just a little upset since I was starting to think you were calling me out here to confess.
lines.zh: : 可以跳。我只是有点失落,因为我开始以为你叫我出来是要表白。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor22
: Ahh, yes. What better time to confess than the 24 hours following the revelation that your husband is still alive?
lines.zh: : 啊,对。还有什么时机比得知丈夫还活着后的这 24 小时更适合表白呢?

lines.en: : Jokes aside, if you didn’t call me out here to talk about that...why {i}did{/i} you call me out here?
lines.zh: : 不开玩笑了,如果你叫我出来不是为了谈那个……那你叫我出来是为了什么?

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor23
: To thank you.
lines.zh: : 为了谢谢你。

lines.en: : Me? For what?
lines.zh: : 我?谢什么?

lines.en: : For also feeling that tension and never giving into it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你同样感觉到了那股张力,却从未顺从它。

lines.en: : I thought we weren’t going to-
lines.zh: : 我以为我们说不谈——

lines.en: : We’re not. It’s...something much bigger than {i}just{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 我们是不谈。这是……比那大得多的事。

lines.en: : It’s something that’s been an unavoidable part of who I am for years now...a part that I never figured out how to address until meeting {i}you{/i} brought on a whole bunch of new challenges.
lines.zh: : 这是多年来一直无法回避地存在于我身上的一部分……一部分我从来不知道该怎么面对的东西,直到遇见{i}你{/i},带来了一连串新的考验。

lines.en: : You can say it’s due to an overwhelming lack of men or something like that...
lines.zh: : 你可以说这是因为身边实在没有男人什么的……

lines.en: : But you are the exact sort of temptation I have always feared I’d face.
lines.zh: : 但你正是我一直害怕自己会遇到的那种诱惑。

lines.en: : I get lonely very easily. I’m sure you know that much about me by now. And it’s that sort of loneliness that makes me think things I shouldn’t sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我很容易感到孤独。我想你现在已经很了解我这一点了。而正是那种孤独,有时会让我生出不该有的念头。

lines.en: : And maybe it’s like Rin said. Maybe just thinking things and never actually {i}doing{/i} them is fine...but it sure as shit doesn’t feel that way.
lines.zh: : 也许就像 Rin 说的。也许光是想、而不真的去{i}做{/i}就没关系……可感觉上绝对不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Having you around...made me think a bunch of things all the time. Things that seemed like magic in the moment, but tapeworms once the moment faded.
lines.zh: : 有你在身边……让我时时刻刻都在胡思乱想。那些念头在当下像魔法,等那一刻过去,就成了绦虫。

lines.en: : I found myself trying to appeal to you without even realizing it.
lines.zh: : 我发现自己不知不觉地在试图吸引你。

lines.en: : Unbuttoning my blouse when you walk into the store...{i}forgetting{/i} my wedding ring at home so it would look like I wasn’t committed.
lines.zh: : 你走进店里时解开上衣的扣子……把婚戒「{i}忘{/i}」在家里,好显得我没有在婚姻里。

lines.en: : And, honestly...if you’d have pursued something with me...I really think I would have let those compulsions of mine win.
lines.zh: : 而且说真的……如果你当时对我展开了追求……我真的觉得我会让那些冲动赢的。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor24
: But you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 可你没有。

lines.en: : And sure, you might joke about how you’d be completely fine with throwing all of that away and starting an actual affair with me-
lines.zh: : 当然,你也许会开玩笑说,你完全不在乎抛下一切,跟我来一场真正的婚外情——

lines.en: : But you’re the one who held back when I was ready to bend.
lines.zh: : 但在我准备屈服的时候,是你收住了。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is why I wanted to thank you.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是我想谢谢你的原因。

lines.en: : You protected me from myself when I’ve always been my own worst enemy.
lines.zh: : 你保护了我,让我躲开我自己——而我一直是自己最大的敌人。

lines.en: : I don’t know if you did it {i}to{/i} protect me...or if you had some other sort of motive in mind...or even if you’re just flat out unattracted to me.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你这么做{i}是为了{/i}保护我……还是另有目的……甚至只是单纯对我没兴趣。

lines.en: : But whatever reason it was that we became what we are today instead of what I fantasized about...
lines.zh: : 但不管是什么原因,让我们成了今天的样子,而不是我曾经幻想的那样……

lines.en: : I’m thankful for that reason.
lines.zh: : 我都感谢那个原因。

lines.en: : I’m thankful for you.
lines.zh: : 我感谢你。

lines.en: : And I seriously can’t thank you enough.
lines.zh: : 我真的感激不尽。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor25
: I feel like I’m going to stop forgetting my ring as much when I leave the house now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得,以后出门的时候,我应该不会再那么频繁地「忘」带戒指了。

lines.en: : There’s not really anyone I feel the need to appeal to like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 已经没有什么人让我觉得需要那样去讨好了。

lines.en: : Because, thanks to a certain close friend of mine, I now understand that there’s more than one way to dispel loneliness.
lines.zh: : 因为多亏了我的一位密友,我现在明白了,驱散孤独的方法不止一种。

lines.en: : That there are plenty of ways to feel full without being filled up.
lines.zh: : 有很多方式可以感到满足,而不需要被填满。

lines.en: : Because at the end of the day...what I already have should be enough for me.
lines.zh: : 因为说到底……我已经拥有的,对我就该足够了。

lines.en: : And that reaching for any more would just be greedy.
lines.zh: : 再伸手去要更多,只是一种贪婪。

lines.en: : Want to make out?
lines.zh: : 想接吻吗?

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不想。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor26
: Wow. You really have turned over a new leaf.
lines.zh: : 哇。你真的洗心革面了。

lines.en: : Back in the beginning, you’d just make out with me without even asking.
lines.zh: : 最开始的时候,你连问都不问就会直接吻上来。

lines.en: : Okay, first off, that only happened one time and I was extremely drunk.
lines.zh: : 好吧,第一,那只发生过一次,而且我当时醉得厉害。

lines.en: : Second, I’m still kind of upset about it. So don’t joke like that.
lines.zh: : 第二,我到现在还有点介意。所以别开这种玩笑。

lines.en: : Third, do you even {i}want{/i} to make out with me? Or do you just feel weird that I forced you into a sentimental conversation when your biggest goal in life is to avoid those?
lines.zh: : 第三,你到底{i}想不想{/i}跟我接吻?还是说你只是觉得别扭——我硬拉着你进行了一场感伤的对话,而你人生最大的目标就是躲开这种东西?

lines.en: : Yes and yes.
lines.zh: : 两个都是。

lines.en: : Well, too bad. Because a phone call I received yesterday has reminded me of just how long I am willing to wait.
lines.zh: : 那可真遗憾。因为我昨天接到的那通电话提醒了我,我到底愿意等多久。

lines.en: : And no handsome man with a well-defined body and mysterious aura will change that.
lines.zh: : 任何身材轮廓分明、气质神秘的大帅哥都改变不了这一点。

lines.en: : If only I was less mysterious.
lines.zh: : 我要是没那么神秘就好了。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor27
: Yes. If only.
lines.zh: : 是啊。要是就好了。

lines.en: A moment of silence washes over the two of us as the streets finally begin to fill with people.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默漫过我们两人,街道终于开始挤满了人。

lines.en: But seeing as we’ve already passed the points of our conversation that demand secrecy, I don’t see much of an issue with it.
lines.zh: 不过考虑到我们已经聊过了那些需要保密的部分,我觉得也没什么大碍。

lines.en: To anyone who passes by, we probably just look like lovers.
lines.zh: 在任何一个路过的人眼里,我们大概就像一对恋人。

lines.en: Ironically enough, that’s the one thing we’ll never be.
lines.zh: 讽刺的是,那恰恰是我们永远不可能成为的东西。

lines.en: Haruka’s heart belongs to someone else.
lines.zh: Haruka 的心属于另一个人。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
I’m just the man who took it.
lines.zh: 我只是那个拿走了它的人。

lines.en: else:
And it’s not as if I’d take it anyway.
lines.zh: 而且我本来也不会拿。

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor25
: Anyway...
lines.zh: : 总之……

lines.en: : I guess it’s about time we head back in.
lines.zh: : 我想我们也该回去了。

lines.en: : All those people on the street will soon remember they need coffee in order to survive and then turn to me in desperation.
lines.zh: : 街上那些人很快就会想起来,他们要靠咖啡才能活下去,然后绝望地转向我。

lines.en: : You’re going to stay here?
lines.zh: : 你要留在这儿?

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor28
: I mean...yeah. That {i}is{/i} my job.
lines.zh: : 我是说……对。这{i}是{/i}我的工作。

lines.en: : I just figured you might want to go spend time with Maki or something since she’s already on her way to the bar.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为,既然她已经在去酒吧的路上了,你可能会想去陪陪 Maki 什么的。

lines.en: : She hasn’t shown any weakness to {i}me{/i} yet, but I’m pretty sure that brave facade she’s putting on won’t last nearly as long as she wants it to.
lines.zh: : 她{i}在我面前{/i}还没有露出任何软弱,但我很确定,她那副勇敢的伪装撑不了她想要的那么久。

lines.en: : Having another friend around might be good for her.
lines.zh: : 身边有个朋友陪着,对她也许是好事。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you cared so much about her.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你这么在乎她。

lines.en: : Who says {i}she’s{/i} the one I care about?
lines.zh: : 谁说我在乎的是{i}她{/i}了?

lines.en: scene harukaoutdoor29
: Ahh...
: I’d have to call Molly in.
lines.zh: : 那我得把 Molly 叫来。

lines.en: : Do you think she and Rin will be able to get along for the rest of the day? Or are they still on bad terms?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她们俩和 Rin 今天剩下的时间能相处得来吗?还是说她们还闹着别扭?

lines.en: : Beats me. There’s only one way to find out, isn’t there?
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道。只有一种办法能弄清楚,不是吗?

lines.en: : I guess so...
lines.zh: : 大概是吧……

lines.en: : Here’s hoping I still have a cafe to return to tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 就祈祷我明天回来的时候,咖啡馆还在吧。

lines.en: scene black
I leave Haruka’s side and blend in with the crowd as I begin to ponder over what else I can possibly do today.
lines.zh: 我离开 Haruka 身边,混进人群,开始琢磨今天还能做点什么。

lines.en: I toy with the idea of showing up to the bar as well, but...
lines.zh: 我也动过干脆去酒吧的念头,不过……

lines.en: I think that whatever is going on there would probably be best left between the girls.
lines.zh: 我觉得那边发生的一切,最好还是留给那些女孩们自己。

lines.en: I don’t belong anywhere with that level of uninhibited emotion.
lines.zh: 我属于不了一个充满那种毫无保留的情绪的地方。

lines.en: Where I do belong is amidst a sea of faceless others, each focusing solely on where the day will bring them.
lines.zh: 我真正属于的地方,是无脸人群的汪洋之中,每个人都只关注这一天会把自己带向何处。

lines.en: Paying no mind to me.
lines.zh: 没有人会注意到我。

lines.en: So to anyone who passes by, ignore me.
lines.zh: 所以,所有路过的人,请无视我。

lines.en: I’ll figure out where to go on my own.
lines.zh: 我自己会找到要去的地方。

lines.en: Just focus on yourself.
lines.zh: 你只管顾好自己。

lines.en: Find your own way home.
lines.zh: 找到你自己的回家路。
